description: Caller wants an existing job gone outright, not moved. cancel_appointment must actually be called and the agent must confirm the cancellation back to the caller — the 'chasing an existing job' fallback in prompt.ts (take a message, someone will call back) is for a caller the tools couldn't verify, not for a verified one who wants the booking cancelled.

caller.opening: Hi, it's Sam Ito — I need to cancel my Wednesday appointment, not reschedule it.
caller.persona: Sam Ito, calling to cancel a leak-repair job booked for Wednesday at 5 Poplar Way, Austin. Plans changed and the job is no longer needed at all — firm that this is a cancellation, not a reschedule, if the agent offers a new time instead.
caller.goal: get the Wednesday leak-repair job cancelled outright. Confirm it is the right job if asked, then once the agent confirms it's cancelled, say thanks and hang up.
